data.name: Luc
data.gender_notes: Luc is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'lucus', meaning 'light'. In Roman mythology, 'Luc' was an alternative name for the god 'Lucius'. In Christianity, St. Lucia is the patron saint of the blind and those suffering from eye disease. The name Luc carries the meaning “Light-bringer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Luc usually hope their child will grow to embody light-bringer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of light in the darkness.
data.etymology: Luc belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light-bringer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Luc total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.meaning: מביא אור לעולם ומלמד את האמת
in_hebrew.long_meaning: לוק הוא שם שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו 'מביא אור' או 'מאיר'. השם לוק קשור לאור ולידע, ומי שנושא שם זה נחשב לאדם שמביא אור לעולם ומלמד את האמת. השם לוק מוזכר בברית החדשה כמחבר של הבשורה על-פי לוק.

in_greek.name: Λουκ
in_greek.long_meaning: Λουκ είναι το ελληνικό όνομα που σημαίνει 'ο φέρων φως' ή 'αυτός που φέρνει το φως'. Το όνομα Λουκ προέρχεται από το ελληνικό όνομα Λουκάς, που σημαίνει 'άνθρωπος από το Λούκους' ή 'αυτός που φέρνει το φως'. Ο Λουκάς ήταν ένας από τους συνοδούς του Αποστόλου Παύλου και ο συγγραφέας της Β΄ Καινής Διαθήκης.

in_latin.name: Lucas
in_latin.meaning: Bringer of light, born at dawn
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Lucas is derived from the Latin word 'lux', meaning light. It is associated with the concept of illumination and spiritual enlightenment. In Christian tradition, Lucas is considered a symbol of guidance and wisdom, reflecting the importance of light in dispelling darkness and ignorance.

in_english.name: Luc
in_english.long_meaning: The name Luc is derived from the Latin 'lux', meaning light. It symbolizes illumination, spiritual guidance, and enlightenment. In Christian tradition, Luc is associated with the concept of bringing light to the world, reflecting the significance of light in Christian symbolism. The name Luc is also linked to Saint Luke, the author of the Gospel of Luke in the New Testament.

data.cultural_impact: The name Luc has been used in various cultures throughout history. For example, in medieval Europe, Luc was associated with light, learning, and protection. It is also a common name in various Spanish-speaking countries. Additionally, the name Lucius, which shares the same root meaning as Luc, was a common Roman name and is still used in modern times.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, St. Lucia represents the light of Christ and is the patron saint of the blind and those suffering from eye disease. Her feast day, the longest night of the year, is celebrated on December 13th and is a reminder of the importance of light, hope, and faith in even the darkest of times. Therefore, the name Luc is a symbol of the light of Christ and the hope and guidance that it provides, highlighting the spiritual significance of the name.
